mapper.select: SELECT PNO, SOURCE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, REGION, TARGET_AGE, START_DATE, END_DATE, APPLY_START_DATE, APPLY_END_DATE, REG_DATE FROM POLICY WHERE PNO = #{pno}
SELECT DISTINCT REGION FROM POLICY WHERE REGION IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE REGION WHEN '중앙부처' THEN 1 WHEN '기타' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, REGION
SELECT PNO, SOURCE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, REGION, TARGET_AGE, START_DATE, END_DATE, APPLY_START_DATE, APPLY_END_DATE, REG_DATE FROM POLICY WHERE SOURCE_ID = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POLICY (SOURCE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, REGION, TARGET_AGE, START_DATE, END_DATE, APPLY_START_DATE, APPLY_END_DATE, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{sourceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{region,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetAge,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{applyStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{applyEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{regDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE POLICY SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CATEGORY = #{category}, REGION = #{region,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TARGET_AGE = #{targetAge,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DATE = #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, END_DATE = #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, APPLY_START_DATE = #{applyStartDate,jdbcType=DATE}, APPLY_END_DATE = #{applyEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE PNO = #{pno}
